verdict.rationale: Workable publishes an official MCP server, documented first-party at its developer reference, with a hosted endpoint (mcp.workable.com/mcp), OAuth2 with dynamic client registration, and tools spanning recruiting and HR workflows. An AI-native user can connect an agent directly to it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Workable MCP server provides full programmatic access to the Workable recruiting and HR platform.
Bridges AI assistants directly with the Workable platform
